text:
maya: Quick sync: product wants a compact 'route snapshot' UX in console analytics that bundles per-route filters, pinned models, selected saved query, and a lightweight quota/cost preview. Need input from platform + telemetry on storage shape and preview costs.
kevin: Good call. Two immediate concerns: backend snapshot schema (minimal) and how to surface a cost/quota estimate without expensive telemetry scans.
rachel: My suggestion for schema: store route_id, list of model_refs, a compact filter fingerprint, sample_window_seconds, and optional precomputed cost/token estimates. Keep it intentionally smallno telemetry dumps. :+1:
sam: UX: toggle between Live / Snapshot. If the routing policy changed since snapshot creation, show a delta badge ("policy changed") and let users preview with current policy or original one.
maya: Also make snapshots importable/exportable across Dedicated/Private. Draft API example below (as a code snippet for discussion):
```json
{
  "snapshot_id": "snap_2026_001",
  "route_id": "route-frontend-checkout",
  "pinned_models": ["redwood/fast-v1", "redwood/lowcost-v1"],
  "filter_fingerprint": "ff_9a8b7c",
  "sample_window_seconds": "3600",
  "token_estimate": "9800",
  "cost_estimate_usd": "9.81",
  "created_by": "maya",
  "created_at": "2026-03-12T14:02:00Z"
}
```
kevin: Fine shape. A couple notes: token_estimate should be optional and flagged as "cached_estimate". If telemetry sampling is low, GET should return null and we surface a "Recompute estimate" action that calls a lightweight estimator endpoint. Also add routing_policy_hash so we can diff later.
rachel: Agreed on routing_policy_hash. Telemetry plan: emit SnapshotPreviewRequested events with labels {snapshot_id, user, preview_mode} so we can monitor which previews correlate with regressions post-rollout. Metric labels: preview_mode=(snapshot|live|mixed).
sam: For quotas, avoid heavy queries. Proposal: when snapshot is created, capture a coarse quota_burn_rate (tokens/min) and store projected_24h_burn. Show that in UI and a button "Recompute now (fast)" that runs the rate-limited estimate endpoint.
ops-bot: FYI: routing-policy-service had a canary deploy on 2026-03-09 23:01 UTC. Policy hashes may differ for snapshots created before that. :rotating_light:
maya: UI mock idea: saved snapshot card shows chips: [models:2] [est:$9.8] [sample:1h] [policy:changed]. Clicking policy chip opens a diff modal with before/after routing targets.
kevin: Implementation detail: don't store full model configs. Store model_ref and model_config_hash only. Keep filter_fingerprint for indexing.
rachel: Telemetry/events: SnapshotCreated, SnapshotPreviewRequested, SnapshotEstimateRecomputed, SnapshotDeleted. Include route_id and visibility label (personal/team/org) to support access control metrics.
sam: Rollout compatibility: if a pinned model is mid-rollout (<100%), mark snapshot as "at-risk" and offer a fallback suggestion (auto-switch to stable variant). We'll consult rollout-service for rollout_percent.
maya: Action list: 1) proto for snapshot CRUD and estimate endpoints 2) small index table (route + fingerprint) 3) lightweight estimate endpoint + rate limits 4) UI chips + policy diff modal + Live/Snapshot toggle 5) telemetry events + rollout checks + RBAC scoping.
kevin: I'll sketch the proto this afternoon. Nominal endpoints: POST /api/v1/snapshots -> create; GET /api/v1/snapshots/:id?estimate=(cached|fast|live) -> returns snapshot metadata; POST /api/v1/snapshots/:id/recompute -> triggers fast estimate (rate-limited).
rachel: I'll own telemetry instrumentation and event docs. Include metric to count "preview followed by deploy regression" (correlate SnapshotPreviewRequested with regression alerts).
sam: UX nit: when model refs in a snapshot no longer exist, show inline fallback text: "model not found — suggest closest compatible model" and surface a tiny changelog.
maya: I'll draft the PR with API shape + small UI mock tomorrow. Anyone object? :sparkles:
kevin: Go ahead. I'll put a proto sketch and sample curl in #eng-platform when ready.
rachel: I'll coordinate metric names with observability team.
sam: I'll prototype the policy diff view.
ops-bot: Reminder: telemetry indexing maintenance scheduled 2026-03-15 02:00-03:00 UTC. Previews may be stale during that window.
maya: Thanks all, adding maintenance note to docs. :thumbsup:
